1011vc-anchorage-digital:lever:5275f2de-.description: At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto. Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot. We are looking for a Business Development Analyst, Stablecoins, to work closely with the Stablecoins commercial organization and support go-to-market execution across the stablecoins solutions business, including issuance, distribution, and strategic partnerships. You will help turn market signals into actionable GTM initiatives and support live commercial conversations from first outreach through execution. This is a high-ownership, high-learning role for someone early in their career who wants deep exposure to how stablecoins are actually brought to market at scale.
